## Purpose and task

Explain the outcome and connection to Fidret's purpose. Link the issue and repository task record; for a trivial correction, capture the task here.

## AI-DLC

Link the task's profile/depth, stage dispositions, gate authority and acceptance traceability. For a trivial correction, record those compactly here. Identify skipped stages with reasons, verification evidence and operation/publication status. Apply the default workflow without requiring a command.

## Ownership and changes

Name the human owner and assisting harness. Describe the meaningful changes and any coordination with other work.

## Decisions and claims

Link durable decisions. Identify proposed choices, changed commitments, or evidence supporting new claims. State any human decision still pending.

## Verification

Record commands or review steps and results, including relevant failure cases and any checks not run. For website changes, follow the [craft rules](../docs/design/fidret-design-brief.md#website-craft-rules): state the reader’s task, the concrete clutter/confusion removed, why any new treatment helps, and the viewport, keyboard and text-enlargement checks actually performed.

For public-site changes, record the SEO/GEO review: affected canonical URLs, metadata/schema/author/date consistency, initial HTML, published-only discovery and any crawler/performance implications. The shared check must pass, including SEO/GEO failure fixtures. Confirm actual current-head required checks before merge; do not claim rankings or AI citations from local tests. Follow [the search standard](../docs/collaboration/search-quality.md).

## Handoff and review

Link the updated task checkpoint: remaining work, next action, blockers, acceptance basis and last verification. Distinguish local changes/commits, push, PR, merge and actual deployment, and local validation from checks actually run on GitHub. Record pending human decisions without inferring acceptance; request review from the other contributor when they have access.
